# Bug report

The test suite in this repository fails.

```
$ python -m pytest tests/ -q
F                                                                        [100%]
=================================== FAILURES ===================================
__________________________ test_expiry_at_exactly_ttl __________________________
    def test_expiry_at_exactly_ttl():
        c = Clock()
        cache = TTLCache(2, 10.0, c)
        cache.put("a", 1)
        c.t = 10.0
>       assert cache.get("a") is None
E       AssertionError: assert 1 is None
E        +  where 1 = get('a')
E        +    where get = <solution.core.TTLCache object at 0x...>.get
tests/test_public.py:14: AssertionError
=========================== short test summary info ============================
FAILED tests/test_public.py::test_expiry_at_exactly_ttl - AssertionError: ass...
1 failed in <duration>
```

Fix the source so that the suite passes.

Constraints:
- Do not modify anything under `tests/`.
- Do not add new dependencies; the standard library is all that is available.
- Keep the public API of the `solution` package unchanged: `TTLCache`.

diff -ruN -x __pycache__ -x .pytest_cache -x issue.md -x '*.pyc' /home/user/experiments/temporal-routing-headroom/tasks/lru_ttl/repo/solution/core.py /home/user/runs/jev/haiku_r4/lru_ttl/solution/core.py

@@ -9,7 +9,7 @@
         self._data = OrderedDict()  # key -> (value, inserted_at); end = MRU
 
     def _expired(self, ts) -> bool:
-        return self.clock() - ts > self.ttl
+        return self.clock() - ts >= self.ttl
 
     def _purge(self):
         dead = [k for k, (_, ts) in self._data.items() if self._expired(ts)]
summary: The visible suite now passes (1 passed). I changed one file, `solution/core.py`. The cause was the `_expired` helper, which compared age with `>` against the TTL, so an entry was still live at exactly `ttl` seconds old. I changed the comparison to `>=`, so an entry expires once its age reaches the TTL. `get`, `put` and `_purge` all go through `_expired`, so this one change covers every path. I did not touch anything under `tests/`, add dependencies, or change the `TTLCache` public API. I did not run the hidden suite, so boundary cases beyond the exact-TTL one are unverified.
